sourceText: User asked to continue the next group and then complete the remaining 10x15 baseline groups after G02.
normalizedOutcome: Implement only G03 in this story as an independent prose-only negative-control baseline: all 15 required rows are present and contain completion wording, none has machine closure evidence, zero rows close, full roadmap completion is blocked, and documentation says G01-G03 are implemented while G04-G10 remain future.
acceptanceClaim: G03 is DONE only if the standalone G03 smoke passes and the baseline document says G03 is implemented without claiming the full 10x15 baseline is complete.
